mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) levels signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, directly improving corporate revenue outlooks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1250 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces corporate borrowing capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls per trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Supply contractions (INDPRO < 100) indicate manufacturing output decline and rising input costs, reducing corporate production capacity and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank policy tightening and reduced real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240 (index).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1250 thousand units indicate weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 1250 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) signals strong retail activity and household consumption, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with falling interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal stimulative economic conditions with increased consumer purchasing power and lower borrowing costs, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS falls per trigger condition.
